story.title: Our Thrilling Adventure to the Prehistoric Times
paragraphs_en: When Aryan and I were on our way to the market, we saw a laboratory. Curiously, we sneaked up into the building and stepped inside the laboratory and screamed on top of our lungs, "helllooooooo, anybody home?". But there was no answer.
We went up the elevator and reached the top floor of the tall building. We found ourselves on its 55th floor. We entered a room...

We slipped into its capsule. There we saw many glowing buttons and signs. We figured out how to operate this futuristic gadget and were able to make out the journey buttons for 'Prehistoric Times', 'Volcano Land' and one for the 'Deep Deep Sea'.

We hit on 'Prehistoric Times' and found ourselves face to face with the T Rex, Triceratops, Stegosaurus, Velociraptors... And guess what? We even got a glimpse of the Fire-raptor and the Water-raptor!
There was chaos everywhere! Volcanoes were erupting and Tsunamis were raging in the background. Earthquakes and cyclones were on their way too. Nature was showing its fury. It was a war-zone!
We hastened back to the laboratory and realised that we had completely forgotten about the fruits we had been asked to bring from the market!!!
We got a bad scolding from our mothers. It was more furious than the tsunamis, cyclones, earthquakes and the volcanoes put together.
Inspite of all the scolding and crying, we were very excited and shared our thrilling adventure with all our friends. Not sure if they believed us...but who cares!
